5289-6927-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
5289-6927-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Graaz, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Damage Control Crew token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4289-4770-5301-7060.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1339-7920-8095.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-7920-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Tresserhorn's Lord triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

2169-3899-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2169-3899-4694-7306.description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {U}{G}, causing each creature you control to enter with an additional +1/+1 counter this turn.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Zameck Guildmage.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1981-2415-2921-5933.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Popular Egotist and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

1496-1981-2415-4247.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1496-1981-2415-4247.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2511-6972-7934.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Federation Field Medic.
When Federation Field Medic dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Federation Field Medic enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

1921-2034-7895.description:
Activate Tawnos's second ability by paying {1}{W}{U}{B}, tapping it and sacrificing two artifact tokens, exiling Little Bear from your graveyard and creating a token copy of it that is an artifact in addition to its other types.
When the Little Bear token enters, it triggers, untapping Tawnos.
Activate Tawnos's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Little Bear token and causing you to mill two cards.
When the Little Bear token enters, it triggers, untapping Tawnos.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Little Bear token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.

348-1152-4867-7316-7548.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
348-1152-4867-7316-7548.description:
Cast Traitorous Greed by paying {3}{R}.
Forum Necroscribe triggers, returning Cormela from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve Traitorous Greed, untapping Priest of the Forgotten Gods, giving it haste until end of turn, and adding {R}{R}.
Activate Priest of the Forgotten Gods by tapping it, sacrificing Cormela and any creature not part of the combo.
When Cormela dies, it and Rat King triggers.
Resolve the Cormela trigger, returning Traitorous Greed from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Rat King trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Priest of the Forgotten Gods ability, causing any number of opponents to sacrifice a creature and lose 2 life, adding {B}{B}, and drawing a card.
Repeat, sacrificing the newly created token in step 4 instead of the additional creature.

2921-3054-5346-6809.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire.
When Oathsworn Vampire dies, Crime Novelist and Scion of Opulence trigger.
Resolve the Crime Novelist trigger, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Scion of Opulence trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5256-6972-7724.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Wakandan Royal Guard.
When Wakandan Royal Guard dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wakandan Royal Guard enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

1434-7546-7683.notablePrerequisites: You have a storm count of 1 or higher.
1434-7546-7683.description:
Cast a copy of Maestro's Gift by paying {3}{U}{R}, targeting Inspired Skypainter.
Maestro's Gift's storm ability triggers, copying it for each spell cast before it this turn. Choose to have each copy target Prismari.
Resolve the first copy of Maestro's Gift targeting Prismari, creating a token copy of Prismari with haste.
Repeat step 3 for each remaining copy of Maestro's Gift that targets Prismari.
Resolve the final copy of Maestro's Gift, creating a token copy of Inspired Skypainter with haste. It'll enter prepared due to its static effect.
Cast a copy of Maestro's Gift by paying {3}{U}{R}, targeting Inspired Skypainter.
Maestro's Gift will have a storm ability for each Prismari you control, and each storm ability will trigger.
Resolve the first storm trigger, copying Maestro's Gift for each spell cast before it this turn. Choose to have each copy target Prismari.
Repeat step 3 for each copy created in step 8.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 for each remaining storm trigger from step 7.
Repeat from step 5 as mana allows.
1434-7546-7683.notes: The listed mana cost is a suggested cost - you may use less mana, but you'll get less tokens. You can also compensate for less mana by having a higher storm count. It isn't required for each Maestro's Gift to copy Prismari, but doing so will net you more storm triggers the next iteration. On the last iteration, you can target whatever creature(s) you desire.

339-677-6798-7296.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

628-2921-7218.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Reaping Willow.
When Reaping Willow dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability
Repeat.

3490-4289-7075-7175.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-4289-7075-7175.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

2232-2511-3821-6843.easyPrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
2232-2511-3821-6843.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
Cast Anti-Venom by paying {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
When Anti-Venom enters, its first ability and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Anti-Venom trigger, returning Peregrine Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Peregrine Drake enters, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Anti-Venom from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Peregrine Drake.
Repeat.

1987-3139-4423-6918.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and The Great Henge by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{U} and causing you to gain 2 life.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and The Great Henge.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

618-3562.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Sky Hussar with haste.
When the Sky Hussar token enters, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

2292-2781-2947.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Vesperlark.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Vesperlark.
When Vesperlark leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2239-5256-6490--88.notablePrerequisites:
You have enough mana available each turn to cast the extra turn spell and enough mana each extra turn to cast Ardent Elementalist.
You have not cast a spell using Kotis
2239-5256-6490--88.description:
Cast the extra turn spell by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your extra turn.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Ardent Elementalist, causing you to mill cards equal to Ardent Elementalist's power.
Cast Ardent Elementalist from your graveyard by paying its mana cost and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, ensuring not to exile the extra turn spell.
When Ardent Elementalist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the extra turn spell from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1228-4050-5470.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to create a creature token this turn.
Goblin Sharpshooter does not have summoning sickness.
1228-4050-5470.description:
Create a creature token.
Activate Goblin Sharpshooter by tapping it, creating a copy of the creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature token dies, Goblin Sharpshooter triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat from step 2.

66-457-5491.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Artificer Class's level 3 ability triggers, creating a token copy of Worldwalker Helm plus a Map token
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping a Worldwaker Helm and a Map, adding {U}{U}.
Activate a Worldwalker Helm by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, creating a token copy of the Worldwalker Helm token plus a Map token for each Worldwalker Helm you control.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping two Maps, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 3.
66-457-5491.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

228-678-3701-4336.description:
Activate Skullclamp's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Kobolds of Kher Keep.
Kobolds of Kher Keep dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness, triggering Enduring Renewal and Skullclamp.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Skullclamp trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1368-2706-4682.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent is unable to pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
You have at least three other cards in your graveyard, plus an additional three cards between your graveyard and/or hand.
1368-2706-4682.description:
Cast Wheel of Fortune from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {2}{R} and exiling three cards from your graveyard, causing each player to discard their hand and draw seven cards.
Smothering Tithe triggers for each card drawn by your opponents, creating that many Treasure tokens.
Activate three of the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}.
Repeat.

784-3327-3719-4284.notablePrerequisites:
Dargo and Silas Renn are your commanders.
You have sacrificed at least two artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
You control a Treasure token.
784-3327-3719-4284.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R} and sacrificing Clone.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Clone from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Clone enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Dargo and create seven Treasure tokens.
Choose to put Dargo into the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}{R}.
Repeat.

2770-3903-3958.description:
Cast Donate by paying {2}{U}, giving control of Moderation to an opponent.
Cast Knowledge Pool by paying {6}.
Whenever the opponent that controls Moderation casts a spell from their hand, Knowledge Pool triggers, exiling that spell.
Because Moderation prevents the opponent from casting more than one spell each turn, the opponent cannot cast the spell permitted by Knowledge Pool, or any other spell that turn.

738-1646-4647-4659-5034.notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls a creature with toughness equal to one.
738-1646-4647-4659-5034.description:
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Acorn Catapult by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting a creature an opponent controls with toughness equal to one.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing Sol Ring and Acorn Catapult, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Acorn Catapult ability, dealing 1 damage to the creature, causing it to die due to having zero toughness, and causing its controller to create a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the opponent's creature dies, Glissa triggers twice, returning Acorn Catapult and Sol Ring from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Acorn Catapult and Sol Ring by paying {5}.
Repeat.

914-1558-3314.notablePrerequisites:
Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
Chulane does not have summoning sickness.
914-1558-3314.description:
Activate Chulane by paying {3} and tapping it, returning Dockside Extortionist from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Treasures, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1622-2232-4939.description:
Cast Burning-Tree Emissary by paying {R/G}{R/G}.
Burning-Tree Emissary enters the battlefield, triggering itself, Cloudstone Curio and Minion Reflector.
Resolve the Burning-Tree Emissary trigger, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Minion Reflector trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Burning-Tree Emissary with haste.
The Burning-Tree Emissary token enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Burning-Tree Emissary trigger, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the nontoken Burning-Tree Emissary from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

215-1376-3464.notablePrerequisites: There are at least five Elves on the battlefield.
215-1376-3464.description:
Activate Priest of Titania by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Priest of Titania.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2557-3525-4152.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Undercity Scrounger.
Undercity Scrounger does not have summoning sickness.
A creature has died this turn.
2557-3525-4152.description:
Activate Undercity Scrounger by tapping it, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Undercity Scrounger.
Repeat.

618-908-5208.description:
Pay {U} to Indigo Faerie to make Kiki-Jiki blue.
Tap Kiki-Jiki to make a copy of Norritt.
Tap the copy to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

2605-3525-3930.notablePrerequisites:
Rimewind Taskmage does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Rimewind Taskmage.
You control at least four snow permanents.
2605-3525-3930.description:
Activate Lotus Vale by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Rimewind Taskmage by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Lotus Vale.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Rimewind Taskmage.
Repeat any number of times.
Repeat steps with a different color for infinite mana of any color.

449-2024-5168.notablePrerequisites: Bloom Tender does not have summoning sickness.
449-2024-5168.description:
Cast Prismatic Lace for {U}, making a permanent you control all colors.
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Seedcradle Witch by paying {2}{W}{G}, giving Bloom Tender +3/+3 until end of turn and untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

751-1283-5068.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Shrieking Drake.
Pay for Talisman to untap Chromatic Orrery.
Return Shrieking Drake to hand using its ability.
